summary: Frontend-only iteration 3 validation at 390x844 (mobile) on http://localhost:8000 after login as Nyx. All 5 accessibility assertions for the mobile drawer PASSED plus all 5 regression areas PASSED (10/10). Verified: aria-controls/aria-expanded on mobile-menu-btn, role=dialog + aria-modal=true + tabindex=-1 on mobile-drawer, aria-expanded toggling false->true on open, focus moved to drawer-btn-terminal ~200ms after open, ESC closes drawer and restores focus to mobile-menu-btn, header X close also restores focus, Tab/Shift+Tab focus trap keeps focus inside drawer (9 focusables, last=pref-sound, first=header .win-ctrl), terminal-input bottom (711px) above taskbar top (759px), all 13 data-testids present, toast-success with role=status, pref-sound uncheck persists across drawer close/reopen and getNotificationPrefs().sound === false, and local tools (browser.workspace.save/list/delete, macro.list) execute without errors.

issues: #titlebar-title text 'SIGNALIS-OS // ARIS-9 // BROWSER MODE' is very low contrast (dark blue on dark navy) and is truncated behind the window controls — near unreadable on mobile
Intro/help lines ('Comandos diretos iniciam com...') render in a very dim teal with weak contrast against the near-black background; the help line is also clipped horizontally without wrapping

action_items: Optional polish only: raise contrast of #titlebar-title and terminal hint text; allow terminal hint line to wrap on narrow viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: close() restores focus to _prevFocus when the drawer had been opened programmatically from a non-button element; if _prevFocus is an element inside a window that was meanwhile closed, focus() silently no-ops — acceptable, guarded by try/catch.

Focus trap only handles Tab keydown while the event target is inside the drawer; focus placed on body (e.g. after programmatic blur) would escape the trap. Not reproducible via normal UI flow, low priority.
First focusable in drawer is the header close button (class win-ctrl, no data-testid). Add data-testid="drawer-close-btn" for robust future tests.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted workspace 'TEST_ws1' via browser.workspace.save/delete; no residual test data (macro save intentionally rejected by validation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static app: start server with 'cd /app && nohup python3 server.py &' (port 8000) — it is NOT supervisor-managed and is often down. Login overlay: #auth-username/#auth-password/#auth-form button[type=submit]. All iteration-3 a11y items are fixed and verified; only cosmetic contrast items remain. macro.save requires steps:[{tool:'<valid tool name>',args:{}}]; browser.workspace.save requires urls:[...] (not tabs).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — previously reported a11y gaps (aria-expanded toggle, dialog role, focus on open, focus restore on close, tab trap) are now correctly implemented in the drawer IIFE in /app/index.html and confirmed live.
